source.author: lucan
source.text: Ast ego curarum, proceres, arcana mearum Expromam, mentisque meae quo pondera vergant.
source.text_original: Ast ego curarum, proceres, arcana mearum / Expromam, mentisque meae quo pondera vergant.
source.text_english: But I will reveal, O nobles, the secrets of my anxieties, and to what side the burdens of my mind incline.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: atque ego curarum repetam decreta mearum:
reuse.text_original: atque ego curarum repetam decreta mearum: /
reuse.text_english: and I shall recount the resolutions of my anxieties:
